'''Traveler''' is the [[horse]] owned by [[Gareth Bryne]].

==Appearance==
Traveler is a large-nosed bay gelding.

==Activities==
When chasing after [[Siuan Sanche]], [[Leane Sharif]], and [[Min Farshaw]], Traveler carried Gareth Bryne across [[Andor]] and [[Murandy]],{{ref/book|5|12}} eventually leading him to [[Salidar]].{{ref/book|5|28}} Traveler was used by Gareth throughout his time as the leader of the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] army, accompanying the [[Amyrlin Seat]] [[Egwene al'Vere]] on a ride{{ref/book|7|12}} and meeting with nobles from Andor and Murandy.{{ref/book|8|17}}

==Trivia==
{{Wiki|Traveller (horse)|Traveler}} was also the name of {{Wiki|Robert E. Lee}}'s horse; his rider was a well-known general from the {{Wiki|American Civil War}}.
